title: Australian-Style Egg Noodle Stir-Fry
description: A simple and quick stir-fry made with Australian-inspired flavors and light noodles. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add Australian seasoning blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add beaten eggs and scramble until cooked through.
Add light noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
